Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You sing the familiar verse just loud enough for your companion to hear. Their shoulders straighten as they turn back to the task.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
One ally within 3 squares who hears you.
Duration
Until the start of your next turn; a next-roll benefit ends when used.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Give the ally a line worth living up to. It gains 1 Boon to its next roll before the start of your next turn; not inventory or wound dice. The same verse does not multiply through repeated uses.

Source: design/cards/a-verse-for-courage.md at 9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3.
